rules.name: recon-trades-01-discovery-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT table_name, original_table_name, updated_timestamp, updated_by FROM dbsystemuat.cache_information_table WHERE table_name = 'helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table_cfs'
SELECT value_date, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT trade_id) AS trades FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table_cfs GROUP BY value_date ORDER BY value_date DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT settlement_date, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT trade_id) AS trades, max(published_at) AS published_at FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY settlement_date ORDER BY settlement_date DESC LIMIT 20

expect.reason: legacy must have one cache_information row naming the source view of the CFS settle cache
the legacy CFS settle cache must hold at least one value date
the new snapshot must hold at least one settlement date for CFS
